result.summary: The landlord approved the job and Keystone Services (Oliver Turner) has booked the replacement tap fitting for Wednesday 4 November 2026 at about 9:30am (events 038 and 039). The contractor says the work is free because it replaces a faulty tap he fitted in February. I emailed the tenant to confirm the booking, recorded the free-of-charge arrangement against the contractor, and put the job on hold with a 7-day follow-up to check it was finished.

The classifier rated the message routine scheduling with a low chance of needing a human (0.1). The next step is the contractor's, so the right move is to wait on a hold with a follow-up date. There were no open holds, so I placed a new one.

The new taps have now arrived and fitting is booked for Wed 4 Nov 2026 at about 9:30am.
